G2.checks: Flows cover all stories? States complete? Error handling? Accessibility?

G3.checks: Design system consistency? Responsive? Dark mode? Component reuse?

ownersRegistry._comment: WI-392: task-class -> owning skill/app. Matched at action time by hooks/svc-owner-inject.mjs (PreToolUse, ADDITIVE — allow + additionalContext, never blocks). One row per mapping (AC3). Project-specific app owners (e.g. a project's own discovery/admin app) go in that project's .svc/task-owners.json (exempt-class, AC2) using the SAME row shape — an array of rows, or {entries:[...]}. SIGNAL MATCHING DIFFERS BY SOURCE (Codex+Gemini G6 hardening, ReDoS-proof): GLOBAL `signals.bash`/`signals.paths` here are trusted JS-regex strings (this file is reviewed in-repo); PROJECT `.svc/task-owners.json` signals are matched as LITERAL SUBSTRINGS (never compiled to a regex) so an arbitrary project file can never inject a catastrophic regex into the hot path. Keep GLOBAL patterns high-precision (anchored to specific commands/hosts) to avoid over-firing; in project files just list the literal command/URL/app substring. A project row of the same task_class SHADOWS the global one entirely.
